newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash crudes take sideline to April expiration.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash crudes take sideline to April expiration.

text.p: U.S. cash crude prices were mostly steady from levels pegged earlier on Thursday, with much of the market focused on expiration of the April NYMEX futures contract, traders said.
Outright April West Texas Intermediate/Cushing was currently trading around 25 cents firmer at $22.25-35 a barrel, recovering strongly from losses in the morning.
Second month futures contracts were staging less of a rally, and were around 10-15 cts higher on the day.
For the grades, deals have been rangebound for the most part, with the Louisiana sweets remaining under pressure.
